name: Akapulu Labs
description: Akapulu Labs is an AI research lab building live conversational avatars.

instructions: Akapulu Labs builds live AI avatars on real-time calls. Two shapes: (1) a hosted link: public page Akapulu Labs hosts; open URL, Start Call; page never sees the API key; (2) your voice pipeline (speech-to-speech or any stack that produces assistant audio) plus Akapulu Labs avatar video in a WebRTC room you create (Daily with Pipecat, or LiveKit with LiveKit Agents). Calls use conversation minutes (akapulu.com/pricing). For agent onboarding (skills, MCP, account, which path to take), follow https://docs.akapulu.com/agent-setup.md.

Hosted links: create in the dashboard or Bearer CRUD on /api/hosted-links/ (GET/POST/DELETE collection; GET/PUT/DELETE by id). Create body is exactly label, avatar_id, system_prompt, show_ai_label. Response includes url and token.

Plugin path (Pipecat / Daily): create_akapulu_call from pipecat-akapulu creates a private Daily room, mints browser/voice-bot/worker tokens, and POST /api/live-sessions/ (transport daily by default). Returns room URL, bot token, browser token, session_id. AkapuluAvatar sits after assistant audio and forwards PCM to the worker. Worker publishes face+audio as Avatar. Use akapulu_daily_params(), avatar.attach(transport), and wait_until_call_ready before greeting. Public example: akapulu-examples (Deepgram Flux flux-general-multi, OpenAI gpt-5.4-mini, Cartesia Sonic 3.6). Code: /guides/calls/pipecat.

Plugin path (LiveKit Agents): create_akapulu_livekit_call or AvatarSession.start from livekit-akapulu. POST /api/live-sessions/ with transport=livekit, wss room_url, room_name, and Avatar JWT (publish_on_behalf). AvatarSession forwards assistant PCM; worker publishes as Avatar. Loading status on LiveKit data topic akapulu.avatar.status (same call_is_ready fields). Wait for wait_until_call_ready; mute session.input until then. Code: /guides/calls/livekit.
Every avatar frame has an invisible mark; verify with POST /api/video-marks/ then POST /api/video-marks/<id>/read/. API errors include error_code: branch on that field, not the English string.
